clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern Barrens, Sunscale raptors claim a secluded valley in the rocky hills west of Northwatch Hold. Their eerie, tool-using cunning and obsessive theft of bright trinkets set them apart from ordinary beasts.

West of Northwatch Hold, Sunscale raptors make their home in the Raptor Grounds. Eerie and far from ordinary beasts, they fashion crude shelters, make primitive tools, and coordinate their hunts. Their obsessive fascination with shiny or unusual things drives them to raid passing caravans and Horde encampments. Coins, trinkets, and supplies disappear into their canyon dens.
